## Project Based Learning 2:02-2:57 in Holiday 206

* There is an entrance ticket on Canvas. (10 minutes or so)
* Students will make a frieze-pattern slideshow using [google slides](slides.new).
    * Students should use this tool to generate the patterns:
        * [https://chadworley.github.io/frieze/frieze.html](https://chadworley.github.io/frieze/frieze.html)
    * Students should create 7 patterns, one of each frieze group. They will screenshot their results to put them into the slideshow.
    * Each slide will say the [frieze group name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frieze_group#Descriptions_of_the_seven_frieze_groups).
    * Each slide will say something about the pattern.
        * What was your process?
        * What does it remid you of?
    * Students will struggle to submit their slideshows. They should first download their slides as a PDF. Then, on the Canvas assignment, they can upload the PDF and submit it.
